title: Organisation Determination and Reconsideration Deadlines on the Employer and Union Group Retiree Plans
content:
A standard organisation determination on a plan of the Employer and Union Group Retiree Plans must be decided within the calendar days scheduled for that plan; an expedited organisation determination must be decided within the hours scheduled for it; and a reconsideration of an adverse determination may be filed within the calendar days scheduled after that determination.

| Group plan | Standard determination, calendar days | Expedited determination, hours | Reconsideration filing window, calendar days |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Standard (PPO) | 14 | 72 | 60 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Enhanced (PPO) | 14 | 72 | 60 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Premium (PPO) | 10 | 48 | 60 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Standard (EGWP) | 14 | 72 | 60 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Enhanced (EGWP) | 14 | 72 | 60 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Premium (EGWP) | 10 | 48 | 60 |

## Boundary readings of the timetable

Each period is a period within which the thing must be done, so the last day or hour of it is itself inside the period. On a plan scheduled at 14 calendar days, a standard determination decided on the 14th calendar day is decided in time and one decided on the 15th is not.

The standard deadline is scheduled in calendar days and the expedited deadline in hours; 48 hours and 10 calendar days are periods of different kinds and are not converted into one another.

The reconsideration window stands at 60 calendar days on every plan of the Employer and Union Group Retiree Plans, whichever determination deadlines that plan is on, and it runs from the adverse determination rather than from the request that led to it.
